main_text.p: Dei & æternam condemnationem incumbere, dum tales perseuerant? An Huberi potius qui contentionis curru raptus per inania paradoxorum, vni-Thef. 60. uersis hominibus, tam securis quàm afflictis, tam incredulis quàm credentibus, omne iudicium iramque diuinam re ipsa, verè & proprie sublata & deleta prædicat? qui indubitater omnes simul ab omni peccato liberatos, & re ipsa totum genus humanũ, sine cuiusquam exceptione, in gratiam & sinum patris per mortem filij receptum asseuerat? Thef.65Thef.49. qui item ad omnes in Adamo perditos, iustitiam & operationem salutis per Christum pertinere asserit, reprobosque omnes æquè ac quoslibet alios per ipsum saluatos, quanta potest ingenij contentione & styli petulantia, defendit? Quapropter culpa potius agnoscat suã, quàm alios tã audacter criminetur.
Obiicit ipse, Si gratia Dei ad omnes non pertinet, quo ore qua fronte minister & præco reconciliationis, in promulgando Euangelio audebit omnes & singulos ad gratiã Dei vocare? Si omnes

page.notes: Marginal references: Thef. 60, Thef. 65, Thef. 49, Thef. 27, Thef. 47 & seq. Page is a plain text page; the final word "nes" at the foot right is the catchword-like continuation "omnes" and is left as printed. Some marginal ditto marks and faint show-through from the reverse page were omitted.
